data.theme: Gender and Demographic Differences in Self-Efficacy and Skills
data.definition: Research examines how gender, class level, transfer status, or first-generation college student status affect self-efficacy, problem-solving perceptions, or skill development, often using validated instruments to compare subgroups.

data.theme: Impact of COVID-19 Pandemic on Student Self-Efficacy and Learning
data.definition: Studies assess changes in self-efficacy and learning capacities due to the COVID-19 pandemic, comparing pre- and post-pandemic perceptions, and identifying factors like age and educational level.

data.theme: Intrinsic Motivation and Its Measurement in Engineering Education
data.definition: Research develops and validates instruments to measure intrinsic motivation among engineering students, often based on Self-Determination Theory, and tests interventions to enhance motivation.
